description: Build the complete backend package: Express app, Prisma schema, all middleware, all route handlers, geocoding/routing/share services, Zod validators, seed data, and test scaffolding. This is the foundational layer — FEAT-002 through FEAT-004 depend on the API contract established here.
steps: 1. Create packages/backend/package.json with exact dependency versions: express@4.18.2, @prisma/client@5.10.2, prisma@5.10.2, zod@3.22.4, cors@2.8.5, helmet@7.1.0, express-rate-limit@7.2.0, nanoid@3.3.7, bcryptjs@2.4.3, jsonwebtoken@9.0.2, morgan@1.10.0. Dev deps: typescript@5.3.3, ts-node@10.9.2, tsx@4.7.1, @types/node@20.11.0, @types/express@4.17.21, @types/cors@2.8.17, @types/bcryptjs@2.4.6, @types/jsonwebtoken@9.0.5, @types/morgan@1.9.9, vitest@1.3.1, @vitest/coverage-v8@1.3.1, supertest@6.3.4, @types/supertest@6.0.2. Scripts: build (tsc), dev (tsx watch src/index.ts), test (vitest run), lint (eslint). Note: nanoid v3.x uses CommonJS require() — do NOT use v4+ ESM-only nanoid.

2. Create packages/backend/tsconfig.json: target ES2020, module commonjs, outDir ./dist, rootDir ./src, strict true, esModuleInterop true, skipLibCheck true, resolveJsonModule true. Include src and prisma directories.

3. Create packages/backend/prisma/schema.prisma with the exact models from the spec: User (id cuid, email unique, password, trips Trip[], createdAt, updatedAt), Trip (id cuid, ownerId optional String, owner optional User relation, sessionId optional String, name, description optional, startLocationName optional, startLatitude optional Float, startLongitude optional Float, endLocationName optional, endLatitude optional Float, endLongitude optional Float, travelMode String default 'driving', routeMode String default 'manual', isPublic Boolean default false, shareToken optional String unique, stops Stop[], routeCache RouteCache optional, createdAt, updatedAt), Stop (id cuid, tripId String, trip Trip relation cascade delete, name, address optional, latitude Float, longitude Float, sequence Int, notes optional, category optional, estimatedVisitMinutes optional Int, visitedAt optional DateTime, skipped Boolean default false, createdAt, updatedAt), RouteCache (id cuid, tripId String unique, trip Trip relation cascade delete, totalDistance Float, totalDuration Float, geometry Json, legs Json, calculatedAt DateTime default now). Datasource: postgresql, url from env DATABASE_URL. Generator: prisma-client-js.
4. Run 'cd packages/backend && npm install && npx prisma generate' to install deps and generate the Prisma client. This must succeed without a live database.

5. Create packages/backend/src/utils/responseHelpers.ts: exports sendSuccess(res, data, statusCode=200) and sendError(res, message, statusCode=400, details?) helpers that wrap responses in {success, data} and {success, error, details} shapes.

6. Create packages/backend/src/utils/navigationUrl.ts: exports buildGoogleMapsUrl(lat, lng, name, mode='driving') as specified in the spec — maps driving/walking/cycling to Google Maps travelmode params.

7. Create packages/backend/src/middleware/errorHandler.ts: Express error handler middleware (4-arg signature) that catches ZodError (422 with field details), Prisma PrismaClientKnownRequestError P2025 (404 not found), Prisma P2002 (409 conflict), and generic errors (500). Logs error in non-test environments.

8. Create packages/backend/src/middleware/auth.ts: optionalAuth middleware that reads Authorization Bearer JWT, verifies with JWT_SECRET, attaches req.user = {id, email} if valid, otherwise sets req.user = null and calls next() (does NOT reject). Also exports requireAuth middleware that calls next() only if req.user exists, otherwise 401.
9. Create packages/backend/src/middleware/rateLimiter.ts: exports geocodeLimiter (1 req/sec per IP, 60/min window) and apiLimiter (100 req/min per IP) using express-rate-limit.

10. Create packages/backend/src/services/GeocodingService.ts: class with async search(query, limit=5) method. Calls https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?q={encodeURIComponent(query)}&format=json&limit={limit}&addressdetails=1 with User-Agent: 'Routeora/1.0 (contact@routeora.app)' header. Returns array of {displayName, lat, lon, placeId, type}. Enforces 1-second minimum between requests via a class-level timestamp guard. Throws on HTTP error.

11. Create packages/backend/src/services/RoutingService.ts: class with async calculateRoute(stops: Array<{lat,lng}>, travelMode='driving') method. Profiles: driving->driving, walking->foot, cycling->cycling. Builds coordinate string '{lng},{lat}' joined by ';'. For >25 waypoints, splits into overlapping segments and merges legs. Calls http://router.project-osrm.org/route/v1/{profile}/{coordinates}?overview=full&geometries=geojson&steps=false. Returns {totalDistance (metres), totalDuration (seconds), geometry (GeoJSON), legs: [{distance, duration}]}. Throws descriptive error if OSRM returns non-2xx or code != 'Ok'. Respects 1-req/sec rate limit between calls.

12. Create packages/backend/src/services/ShareService.ts: exports generateShareToken() using nanoid(21), and buildPublicTripPayload(trip) that strips ownerId, owner (email/password), sessionId from the trip object before returning it to public callers.

13. Create packages/backend/src/validators/tripValidators.ts: Zod schemas — CreateTripSchema (name required string, description optional, startLocationName optional, startLatitude optional number, startLongitude optional number, endLocationName optional, endLatitude optional, endLongitude optional, travelMode enum driving/walking/cycling default driving, routeMode enum manual/optimized default manual), UpdateTripSchema (same fields all optional).

14. Create packages/backend/src/validators/stopValidators.ts: Zod schemas — CreateStopSchema (name required, address optional, latitude required number, longitude required number, sequence required number, notes optional, category optional, estimatedVisitMinutes optional number), UpdateStopSchema (all optional). ReorderStopsSchema: array of {id: string, sequence: number}.
15. Create packages/backend/src/validators/authValidators.ts: RegisterSchema (email string email, password min 8), LoginSchema (email string email, password string).

16. Create packages/backend/src/app.ts: Express app factory. Applies helmet(), cors({origin: FRONTEND_URL, credentials: true}), express.json(), morgan('dev') in non-test, apiLimiter. Mounts routes: /api/auth -> authRouter, /api/trips -> tripsRouter, /api/geocode -> geocodingRouter, /api/share -> sharingRouter (public). Applies errorHandler last. Exports app.

17. Create packages/backend/src/routes/auth.ts: POST /register (validate RegisterSchema, hash password with bcrypt rounds=12, create User, sign JWT, return token+user without password), POST /login (find user by email, compare password, sign JWT), GET /me (requireAuth, return user without password).

18. Create packages/backend/src/routes/trips.ts: all trip CRUD endpoints. GET / lists trips for authenticated user (req.user.id) OR by X-Session-Id header for guests. POST / creates trip, sets ownerId or sessionId. GET /:id returns trip with stops and routeCache, checks ownership (owner match OR session match OR isPublic). PUT /:id updates trip fields. DELETE /:id deletes (owner check). POST /:id/duplicate duplicates trip and all stops with new sequences.

19. Create packages/backend/src/routes/stops.ts: POST /api/trips/:id/stops (create stop with sequence), PUT /api/trips/:id/stops/:stopId (update stop fields), DELETE /api/trips/:id/stops/:stopId (delete, resequence remaining), PUT /api/trips/:id/stops/reorder (validate ReorderStopsSchema, update all sequences in a transaction), PATCH /api/trips/:id/stops/:stopId/visit (set visitedAt=now()), PATCH /api/trips/:id/stops/:stopId/skip (toggle skipped boolean). All endpoints verify trip ownership before mutating.

20. Create packages/backend/src/routes/route.ts: POST /api/trips/:id/route/calculate (load stops ordered by sequence, call RoutingService, upsert RouteCache, return result), GET /api/trips/:id/route (return cached RouteCache or 404), POST /api/trips/:id/route/optimize (call OSRM table service to get optimal order, resequence stops, clear cache, return new order), POST /api/trips/:id/route/confirm-order (mark trip routeMode='manual', return trip).

21. Create packages/backend/src/routes/sharing.ts: POST /api/trips/:id/share (set isPublic=true, generate shareToken via ShareService if none exists, save, return shareToken), GET /api/share/:token (find trip by shareToken where isPublic=true, return public payload via buildPublicTripPayload — NO owner email/password), DELETE /api/trips/:id/share (set isPublic=false, clear shareToken), POST /api/trips/:id/share/regenerate (generate new shareToken).
22. Create packages/backend/src/routes/geocoding.ts: GET /api/geocode/search?q=...&limit=5, applies geocodeLimiter, calls GeocodingService.search, returns results.
23. Create packages/backend/src/index.ts: imports app from ./app, reads PORT from env (default 3001), calls app.listen(PORT, callback that logs 'Routeora API listening on port {PORT}').

24. Create packages/backend/prisma/seed.ts: creates a demo trip named 'Durga Puja 2024 — Kolkata' with all 21 pandal stops from the spec (name, lat, lng, sequence 1-21). Uses Prisma client directly. Exports main() and calls it with catch/finally. Add 'prisma.seed' script to package.json pointing to 'tsx prisma/seed.ts'.
25. Create packages/backend/vitest.config.ts: defineConfig with test.environment='node', test.globals=true, coverage.provider='v8'.

26. Create packages/backend/src/tests/trips.test.ts: API integration tests using supertest against the exported app. Mock Prisma client using vi.mock('../lib/prisma'). Tests: POST /api/trips creates a trip and returns 201 with name; GET /api/trips/:id returns the trip; GET /api/share/:token returns no owner.email or owner.password fields (security test); DELETE /api/trips/:id returns 204. Include a __mocks__/prisma.ts or inline vi.mock factory.

27. Create packages/backend/src/tests/utils.test.ts: unit tests for buildGoogleMapsUrl (driving/walking/cycling modes produce correct Google Maps URLs), generateShareToken (returns 21-char string), reorder sequence logic (given array of stops with sequence updates, sorted order is correct).
28. Create packages/backend/src/lib/prisma.ts: PrismaClient singleton — exports const prisma = new PrismaClient(). All route files import from here so tests can mock one path.
29. Run 'cd packages/backend && npm run build' to verify TypeScript compiles without errors.
acceptance_criteria: cd packages/backend && npm run build exits 0 with no TypeScript errors
cd packages/backend && npx prisma generate exits 0 and generates Prisma client
cd packages/backend && npm test runs vitest and all tests in src/tests/ pass
GET /api/share/:token test confirms no email or password fields in response
buildGoogleMapsUrl test confirms correct URL construction for all three travel modes
findings: All 29 steps implemented. Key decisions: (1) tsconfig.json includes only src/ (not prisma/) to keep rootDir consistent — seed.ts is run directly via tsx, not compiled with tsc. (2) nanoid v3.3.7 used with require() for CJS compatibility. (3) GET /api/share/:token implemented in publicShare.ts router mounted at /api/share. (4) Trip sharing management routes (POST/DELETE /:id/share) in sharing.ts. (5) Stop routes use mergeParams:true for access to :id. (6) findFirst added to Prisma mock for share endpoint test. All three verifications exit 0: build, prisma generate, npm test (16/16 tests pass).
